ci_support_linux_64_python3.10.____cpyth:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '14'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
libheif:
- '1.23'
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.10.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
name: pillow-heif
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pillow-heif
  version: "1.5.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/pillow_heif-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 16b11a37b762ff42da2d36527bb5cb14bd9194c24c389ee911155d6e23c53065

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - match(python, "<3.10")
  script:
    - if: win
      then: if not exist "%LIBRARY_LIB%\libheif.lib" copy "%LIBRARY_LIB%\heif.lib" "%LIBRARY_LIB%\libheif.lib"
    - if: win
      then: set "MSYS2_PREFIX=%LIBRARY_PREFIX%"
    - python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    - if: win
      then: if exist "%LIBRARY_LIB%\libheif.lib" del "%LIBRARY_LIB%\libheif.lib"

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - python
  host:
    - libheif
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools >=67.8
    - wheel
  run:
    - pillow >=11.1.0
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pillow_heif
  - script:
      - pip check
      - python run_test.py
    files:
      recipe:
        - run_test.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/bigcat88/pillow_heif
  repository: https://github.com/bigcat88/pillow_heif
  summary: Python interface for libheif library
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
    - tests/images/heif_other/nokia/COPYRIGHT.txt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jeongseok-meta
    - rxm7706
